findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "safety" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_firewall, url_threat_check · Private data: agent_firewall, work_grade, veritas_notary, token_safety_check, tx_check, delivery_score, url_threat_check, contract_audit, evm_log_decode, wallet_investigate, base_verdict, base_token_price, solana_token_report, threat_intel_bulk, token_exit_matrix, robinhood_exit_check, prompt_guard, pii_redact, content_safety · Public sink: tx_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_firewall, url_threat_check · Private data: agent_firewall, work_grade, veritas_notary, token_safety_check, tx_check, delivery_score, url_threat_check, contract_audit, evm_log_decode, wallet_investigate, base_verdict, base_token_price, solana_token_report, threat_intel_bulk, token_exit_matrix, robinhood_exit_check, prompt_guard, pii_redact, content_safety · Public sink: tx_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
